channel.title: RTPeptide Research Blog
channel.description: Educational articles on peptide research. Research Use Only.

item.title: Understanding GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Metabolic Research
item.description: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists are among the most studied classes of metabolic research peptides. In laboratory models they are examined for their effects on appetite-regulation pathways and glucose-metabolism signaling.

item.title: The Role of Tissue Repair Peptides in Wound-Healing Models
item.description: Tissue repair peptides represent a major research area for regeneration and angiogenesis studies. BPC-157, a 15-amino-acid gastric peptide, is extensively studied for tissue-repair pathways in vitro.

item.title: Mitochondrial Peptides and Cellular Aging: A Research Overview
item.description: Mitochondrial-derived peptides have become a focus of cellular-aging research. MOTS-c, for example, is studied for metabolic homeostasis and insulin-sensitivity pathways.

item.title: Growth Hormone Secretagogues: Mechanisms and Research Applications
item.description: Growth hormone (GH) secretagogues are studied for their ability to stimulate endogenous GH release patterns in endocrine research. CJC-1295 (no DAC) is a GHRH analog examined for sustained GH pulse patterns.

item.title: Cognitive Peptides: Semax and Selank in CNS Research
item.description: Cognitive research peptides target central nervous system pathways. Semax, a synthetic nootropic peptide, is studied for neuroprotection and cognitive-function pathways.

item.title: Anti-Aging Peptide Research: Telomerase and Sirtuin Pathways
item.description: Anti-aging peptide research spans multiple pathways. Epitalon is studied for telomerase activation, while NAD+ is examined for sirtuin-pathway and mitochondrial-energy support.

item.title: Peptide Purity and Lyophilization in Laboratory Research
item.description: Purity and formulation are foundational to reproducible peptide research. Most research peptides are supplied as lyophilized powders, which stabilize the material for storage and transport.

item.title: Research Use Only: Compliance and Responsible Handling
item.description: 'Research Use Only' (RUO) is a strict supply classification. It means a material is provided exclusively for scientific laboratory study and is not a drug, food, supplement, or diagnostic.

item.title: Comparing Dual and Triple Incretin Agonists in Metabolic Studies
item.description: Incretin-based metabolic research has evolved from single to multi-receptor agonists. Semaglutide targets GLP-1; Tirzepatide adds GIP (dual); Retatrutide adds glucagon (triple).

item.title: Copper Peptides (GHK-Cu) in Skin and Tissue Regeneration Research
item.description: GHK-Cu is a copper-peptide complex studied for collagen-synthesis and skin-tissue regeneration pathways. It is a common subject in regeneration research models.

item.title: Sleep and Recovery Peptides: DSIP and Mechanisms
item.description: Sleep and recovery research includes peptides studied for sleep architecture and stress-response regulation. DSIP (delta sleep-inducing peptide) is a representative example.

item.title: Sourcing Research-Grade Peptides: What Laboratories Should Verify
item.description: Sourcing research-grade peptides requires verifying several fundamentals: documented purity, verified sequence, CAS identification, and transparent research-context information.
